summary: The discussion proposes a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions that can run in any language via external workers, enabling Spark Connect to support UDFs in Go, Rust, Swift, .NET, and more. Vote in progress: 0 binding +1 The discussion proposes an optional fallback resolver that will be consulted when an application references a V2 catalog name that has not been pre‑configured in Spark. A trial of automated AI code review using Claude was launched for new Apache Spark pull requests, posting only advisory comments without approvals. The bot triggers on new or updated PRs, respects open review comments, and can be disabled per PR via a GitHub label, with safeguards to limit Jira API usage.
